rules.name: suppressed_reject
rules.statute_ref: DPDP Act 2023 §6 — Consent must be free and easy to withdraw
rules.explanation_template: The option to reject tracking is visually suppressed compared to the 'Accept' button, violating equal consent standards.

rules.name: pre_ticked_consent
rules.explanation_template: A consent checkbox or switch for marketing or data sharing is pre-ticked. Valid consent requires your active opt-in.

rules.name: cookie_wall
rules.statute_ref: EDPB Guidelines 05/2020 on Consent — Cookie walls violate freely-given consent

text_patterns: access to this (website|site) is only possible if you accept
disable your ad blocker or accept cookies

rules.explanation_template: A cookie wall blocks access to content unless you agree to tracking. Under global privacy standards (GDPR, DPDP), consent cannot be coerced as a condition of access.
